description: Bounded edit window for a symbol in ONE call: its body, direct callers as CALL-SITE WINDOWS (±3 lines around each use — the lines that break if the contract changes), callees (location-only), and the impact set. Budgeted: 12 callers by default (full:true for the unabridged lists); bodies:"full" switches callers to whole caller bodies (large).

bodies.description: Caller rendering: "windows" (call-site windows, default) or "full" (whole caller bodies — large)

captureEvidence.description: Opt in to a task-owned evidence receipt from the isolated native regex snapshot profile; no bodies. Requires task.

evidenceOffset.description: Historical evidence page offset; follow nextOffset, pages never imply current currency.

evidenceReceipt.description: Immutable local receipt ID returned by context capture.

evidenceResult.description: Immutable reconciliation result ID; requires parent receipt and section.

evidenceSection.description: Historical receipt page: callers/callees/impact/questions. Result page: added/removed/witnessChanged/questions.

full.description: Return the unabridged result (disables the default budget). Large on big repos.

graph.description: Path to graph.json. OPTIONAL — defaults to CODEWEB_WS or the nearest .codeweb/graph.json above cwd

limit.description: Max items to return (each tool has a sensible default; full:true disables)

symbol.description: A node id (file:label) or a bare label

task.description: Explicit owner ID for evidence capture, review or a historical page; never inferred from the last call.

window.description: Context lines around each call site (default 3)

name: codeweb_context
